program.title: CARL WEATHERS CUT BLOCK
program.subtitle: 12-Week Strength/Muscle Maintenance — Fat Loss Phase (Same Week x12)
program.notes: Repeat this single week for all 12 weeks. Primary lifts are HELD at tested ceiling (+25lb dip belt, +25lb pull-up belt, 120lb sandbag) — do not chase progression in a deficit. If a primary lift feels heavy on a given day, drop reps or 5lb rather than grind. Accessory volume is trimmed ~25% from the mass block. Carries and KB conditioning are the fat-loss lever — these can flex up slightly week to week if recovery allows.

1.goal: Hold strength and muscle at current ceiling while running a calorie deficit. Primary lifts stay fixed at tested max (not the block's original targets). Accessory volume down, conditioning volume steady-to-up. Autoregulate every session — recovery capacity is lower in a deficit than it was in the mass block. Repeat this week for all 12 weeks.
